assertions: Original namespace key/prefix/alias and QName cache/output rules are preserved using JS native containers.
Original normalization and all92namespace identifier declarations are source-grounded, without replacement validators or corrected cache semantics.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task142 ports initialized SvXMLNamespaceMap value entries, independent copy/assignment, complete key/prefix/URI operations, aliases/all-entries, QName generation/parsing/cache modes, deprecated key/index APIs and original OASIS/W3 normalization. Native JS Maps/immutable UTF16 strings/output cells adapt unordered-map values and OUString pointer arguments without native bucket/hash/allocator or string lifetime machinery. Nested Maps represent logical QName pair keys. Unspecified native unordered traversal order is not a binary-format promise; membership and complete alias traversal are preserved. Copy construction starts empty caches, assignment/Add retain original stale caches, cold/hot unknown QName writes differ, and existing-prefix Add retains its original resolved-key return. A bounded ordinary JS32k explicit-key fixture checks source automatic allocation into reserved NONE without native memory/exhaustion probes. All92namespace declarations retain native values/aliases; required15resolved XML literal token spellings are source-audited without a fabricated global native token enum/provider. Existing shared ODF_NAMESPACES supplies common URI spellings unchanged. Calc witness targets actual ScSheetSaveData GetAllEntries alias preservation only, not a fabricated sheetdata/filter/document. XML attribute collection/data/item/UNO transport and full Calc pool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing deliberate I/O/recovery differences retained, no broad parity promotion.
